name: Magnezone
description: I theorize that a special magnetic field influenced this Pokémon, changing its molecular structure and causing it to evolve. It emits strange radio waves toward space from its antenna.

moves.name: Thunder Shock
moves.description: The user attacks the target with a jolt of electricity. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

moves.name: Tackle
moves.description: A physical attack in which the user charges and slams into the target with its whole body.

moves.name: Thunder Wave
moves.description: The user launches a weak jolt of electricity that paralyzes the target.

moves.name: Spark
moves.description: The user throws an electrically charged tackle at the target to deal damage. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

moves.name: Tri Attack
moves.description: The user strikes with a simultaneous three-beam attack. This may also leave the target with a burn, paralysis, or frostbite.

moves.name: Flash Cannon
moves.description: The user gathers all its light energy and releases it at once. This may also lower the target’s defensive stats.

moves.name: Thunderbolt
moves.description: The user attacks the target with a strong electric blast. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

moves.name: Thunder
moves.description: A wicked thunderbolt is dropped on the target to inflict damage. This may also leave the target with paralysis.
